data.name: The Second Date's On Us
data.headline: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third: it's a relationship.
data.benefit: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third date? That's a relationship — 15% off your first month and an extra freeze for when life gets busy.
data.rationale: Kenkere logged 3,217 leads in 12 months; only 36% reached a trial and 13.1% converted. 581 single-class sales show high drop-in, low commitment. A booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; freeze has no cash value.

scenes.title: Same Time Next Week

data.name: Same Time Next Week
data.headline: Your pack is nearly out. Same one again, 15% less.
data.benefit: You're nearly out of classes. Take the same pack again at 15% off — ₹7,229 for ten at Copper + Cloves, ₹5,891 for eight — and we’ll add a week of validity so none of them go to waste.
data.rationale: The pop-ups sell class packs, not memberships, so renewal is a repurchase decision rather than an expiry date. Four of the twelve months carried a renewal target with no renewal offer in the catalogue; this is the standing one.
data.audience: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.
data.conditions: 15% off the pack, inside the cap. One per client per pack expiry. The extra week of validity has no cash value.
data.kpi: Packs repurchased within 14 days of running out (target 55%); share of pop-up renewal revenue with an offer behind it.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up The Second Date's On Us in Momence (2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31): Kenkere: Newcomers Intro (first class at 50% off, ₹709) → class 2 free if booked at the desk before leaving, within 7 days → 1 Month (₹12,406) or 8-class pack (₹7,408) at the standard 15% within 72 hours of class 2, plus 1 extra freeze. Pop-ups: paid trial (≈₹945) → second class free if booked before leaving → 8- or 10-class pack at 15% within 72 hours.

steps.label: W2
steps.text: Weekly check: The Second Date's On Us: Second-visit rate (target 55%); trial → member (target 25% vs 18.7%).

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹1.7L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 46 new buyers (140 first visits), 11 renewals and 0 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.

steps.label: W4
steps.text: Close March: tag every redemption by offer ID (O27-xx), log trial attendance and trial→purchase per offer, brief next month.
